description: The Caltrans Performance Measurement System (PeMS) collects traffic data in real time from over 39,000 individual detectors spanning the freeway system across all major metropolitan areas of California, and is also an Archived Data User Service that provides over ten years of data for historical analysis. It integrates information from Caltrans and local agency systems, including traffic detectors, incidents, lane closures, toll tags, census traffic counts, vehicle classification, weigh-in-motion and the roadway inventory. Coverage is regional, the California State Highway freeway system. Access is free but requires an account, which Caltrans typically approves within one to two business days; data are then available through the web interface, which shows speeds, occupancy and changeable message signs, under the site's Conditions of Use. Caveats: the site needs cookies and JavaScript, and extracts published elsewhere (for example on Zenodo) are subsets with their own processing. PeMS supports calibrating and validating traffic flow, incident and capacity models and for studying disruption and recovery on freeways. It complements the Caltrans Traffic Census Program counts and is related to the Caltrans wildfire vulnerability analysis of the State Highway System.
